description: The dsh-qa lane registry. This file is the LANE LIST the suite runs (data, never an inline for-loop in package.json), and it is also the drift ledger: every .mjs under skills/dsh-qa/scripts/ is either a member of a suite or carries an outsideSuites reason. scripts/run-qa-lanes.mjs --list prints it, --check-drift fails when a script is in NEITHER list.

suites.all: the real-lane sweep behind `bun run test:qa:all`: every entry with "all" in suites. Strict by default — the runner passes --no-skip, so a lane whose declared prerequisite is missing reports FAIL++reason instead of SKIP, and the runner classifies that reason as UNAVAILABLE (exit 2, never a pass).
suites.selfTest: the offline sweep behind `bun run test:qa` / `test:qa:strict`: a glob over skills/dsh-qa/scripts/*.mjs --self-test, so it needs no manifest entry and cannot go stale.

verdicts.unavailable: the lane could not run: a SKIP marker, or a FAIL marker whose reason is a prerequisite-absence reason code (a missing prerequisite is never a pass and never a silent failure)
verdicts.fail: the lane ran and failed, exited with a usage error, timed out, or its script is gone from disk

driftRule: On-disk lane scripts with no manifest entry, and manifest entries whose script is gone, are reported by every run and by --list; --check-drift exits 1, and the `qa-lane-drift` gate below runs it inside the `all` suite so drift fails the suite loudly. A lane deliberately outside every suite is declared here with outsideSuites instead of being omitted.
